repository_ledger_location.designation_source: org-contract.json organization_ledger_ref for SV-011/.github. The repository chain is a subtree of that ref. The ref starts empty.
repository_ledger_location.rule: The repository chain is kept in its own subtree of the designated organization ledger ref, published by the same fast-forward push under ORGANIZATION_LEDGER_LOCK. Repository replay walks repository-ledger/<repository>/HEAD.json back through its own receipts and never reads an organization receipt.
